summary: Russia launched a missile strike on a private training ground in Kyiv region during a defense exhibition, killing 10 and injuring nearly 100, prompting criminal investigations. Russian forces conducted multiple attacks using 'Geranium-4' drones on Ukrainian port infrastructure and fuel stations in Chernihiv and Kharkiv regions. Ukraine reported threats of Iskander-M missile launches from Taganrog and increased Russian drone activity across multiple fronts. (Source: @UkraineNow/82899)
key_points: Russia struck a private training ground in Kyiv region during a defense exhibition, killing 10 and injuring nearly 100, with criminal investigations opened. (Source: @UkraineNow/82899)
Russian 'Geranium-4' drones attacked port infrastructure in Nikolaev and fuel stations in Chernihiv/Kharkiv regions, damaging vessels and facilities. (Source: @tass_agency/386994)
Threats of Iskander-M/S-300 missile launches from Taganrog and Kursk region were reported, targeting Ukrainian territory. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69377)
A Polish defense company employee was killed at a drone exhibition in Kyiv region, confirmed by Polish MFA. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31901)
TCC personnel in Lutsk and Krivoy Rog forcibly detained civilians, raising concerns over enforcement practices. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31872)
Allseeds suspended operations in Odesa region due to Russian attacks, citing risks to employees and infrastructure. (Source: @UkraineNow/82901)
ICC prosecutor Karim Khan was dismissed over sexual misconduct allegations amid U.S. efforts to dismantle the court. (Source: @UkraineNow/82914)
Zelensky announced Ukraine will deploy drones with 4,000-10,000 km range by 2026, following improved U.S. relations. (Source: @UkraineNow/82908)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian missile/drone strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure and defense events indicate sustained targeting of military and economic assets. Iskander-M threats from Taganrog suggest potential escalation in precision strikes. Ukraine's expanded drone capabilities may shift frontline dynamics. Russian oil revenue growth highlights continued war funding. (Source: @UkraineNow/82908)
sections.regional_response: Ukraine's TCC enforcement actions in Lutsk/Krivoy Rog raise concerns over civilian treatment. Allseeds' suspension in Odesa reflects economic strain from attacks. Russia's forum with Kazakhstan signals regional cooperation amid war. ICC prosecutor's dismissal amid U.S. pressure complicates international accountability. (Source: @UkraineNow/82901)
